entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.
entries.uk: А, точно, сьогодні ж День святого[n]Валентина. То ось чому сюди стільки[n]хлопців із дівчатами приходило.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.
entries.uk: А в тебе що, нічого цікавого[n]не намічається? Ти ж тут уже[n]майже рік.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...
entries.uk: От коли я був молодий, ого-го...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Sorry. Are you busy?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I looove people who can read the[n]situation.
entries.uk: Обожнюю людей, які все[n]розуміють без слів.

entries.en: Have a seat.
I'll make you some coffee.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So. Been a while. A pret-ty long while.
You been doing okay?
Sorry to worry you.
I've missed you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, yeah! Totally! Just friggin' peachy!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, I'm waaay past the worrying phase.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hee hee. Me too... I mean, wait!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you go to the reformatory without[n]telling me? And then you don't[n]call me after you get discharged?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You really do things your own way,[n]huh...?
Sorry.
My bad.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ugh... I can't get mad at you if you[n]actually apologize...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, I'm just glad you're safe.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Here. As long as we're making up,[n]I can give you this.
Is it chocolate?
This makes me happy.
What's inside?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Yup. You saw it coming, huh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, it's pretty quality stuff. So you[n]gotta eat 'em, okay?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Chocolate. Damn good chocolate, too.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Work's been going pretty smoothly.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: My publisher was going to reassign me[n]to the political department.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: They said it was because I did such[n]a good job contributing to the sales[n]numbers...
entries.uk: Сказали, це за те, що я так добре[n]попрацювала на тиражі...

entries.en: That's amazing.
That's the Ichiko I know.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: A lot of that's thanks to your help,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you better stick with me from now on.[n]Can't miss my rise to the top.
I should tell Ohya that I'm going home...
entries.uk: Треба сказати Ої, що я їду додому...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hey, something wrong?
I'll be going home soon.
I'm going home.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're really serious about this, huh.[n]Even though it'll mean the whole[n]long-distance thing.
Sorry it's so sudden.
I'll visit when I can.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: No, hey, I'm not blaming you.[n]Sometimes you gotta make hard[n]choices.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And honestly, it... seems like the[n]decision's done a lot of good for[n]you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Thanks, but remember you don't have[n]to come running.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: After all, now we can call each other[n]anytime we want.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Something feels different about you[n]now, that's for sure.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So what changed you? Was it life on[n]the inside? Or did you go through[n]something else?
Who knows?
I'm not sure.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Eh, I guess I'm not here to interview[n]you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Speaking of changes, things are a little[n]different for me too.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: All my life, I've had my mind on the[n]job and not a lot else...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But now I've got someone who's just[n]as important as my work.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And if it's for them, well... I think[n]I could do anything.
Who?
Are you talking about...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Could be anyone.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Even if we're far apart, I'll always[n]be with you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you can come to me whenever[n]you need to, okay?
I spent a romantic evening with Ohya...
